metadata.name: policy-tone
metadata.description: Cohort-shared skill for matching the operator's communication tone (formal/casual, brief/discursive, emoji/no-emoji) in any outbound draft. Read-only style analysis; no network calls.

nodes.label: Load prior approved drafts as tone samples

kind.template: Pull the last N=15 communication_log entries with status=approved as tone samples; fall back to operator-provided style guide if no samples exist.
Return ToneStyle: formality (0..1), avg_sentence_len, emoji_rate, opening_pattern, closing_pattern, banned_phrases[].
